Since z is my top preference but I'm only 2nd priority there, I'll rank it first to attempt to secure it. At w, where I'm top priority, I'll rank second to increase my chances. Then y (where I'm also top priority), and lastly x.

By ranking z first, I signal strong interest. My high priority at w and y gives me good fallback options if z doesn't work out. This strategy maximizes my chances of getting a school close to my top preference.
